compiler_spec.ingestion: Ghidra uses its production DocumentStorage/XML parser. Rugra's fixture parses the locked text into the existing structured Element DOM, then invokes the production TreeDecoder and mapped decode functions; production cspec text ingestion is absent and remains MISMATCH.

analysis_options.document_selection: The complete locked x86-64-gcc.cspec is parsed. Observations select default_proto/prototype/input and the top-level MSABI/prototype/input subtrees without reconstructing either resource list.
analysis_options.stack_direction: Locked x86-64 negative-growing stack plus one explicit positive-growing ParamListStandard boundary case.
analysis_options.model_rules: Ghidra decodes every <rule> into ModelRule objects. Rugra currently consumes <rule> subtrees without constructing ModelRule state; rule-dependent assignment behavior remains MISMATCH and is not serialized as a match.
analysis_options.normalization: No temporary ids, pointers, ordering, groups, offsets, or exception text are normalized. Default model identity is serialized as exact map/default pointer or Arc identity.

cases.default_input: Exact <default_proto>/<prototype name='__stdcall'>/<input> subtree from the locked compiler spec, including 8 floating registers, 6 integer registers, one stack pentry, and two model rules.
cases.msabi_input: Exact top-level <prototype name='MSABI'>/<input> subtree from the locked compiler spec, including four two-entry groups, one stack pentry, pointermax, and one model rule.
cases.flipped_stack: Synthetic structured <input> with stack base 100, maxsize 16, align 4 decoded with normalstack=false.
cases.stable_default_identity: Hold the ProtoModel handle returned by decodeProto plus the pre-existing default handle across two setDefaultModel transitions; observe returned/map/default pointer identity and both handles' print-in-declaration mutations.
errors: positive-growth size not divisible by alignment
pentry after a valid model rule

observation_schema.format: One compact UTF-8 JSON object with fixed key and array order plus final newline.
observation_schema.entries: Every ParamEntry in document order with space, offset, size, minsize, alignment, type class, complete group vector, reverse/grouped/overlap flags, and first-in-class flag.
observation_schema.ranges: All getRangeList stack intervals with inclusive endpoints and source space, retaining iterator order.
observation_schema.model: Decoded name/extrapop/derived parameter ranges; Architecture default model name; returned/map/default shared identity; and old/new external handles' print-in-declaration state across default switches.
observation_schema.errors: Exact locked exception message for five malformed/order boundary inputs.

coverage.architecture_default_model_map_arc_ident: MATCH: decodeProto return, map entry, and default retain one stable object; old and new external handles observe both print-flag transitions.
coverage.production_rugra_cspec_text_ingestion: MISMATCH: no production XML text parser or parseCompilerConfig dispatch exists; only the immutable fixture builds Element DOM before TreeDecoder.
coverage.modelrule_decode_and_assignment_state: MISMATCH: <rule> children are consumed but no ModelRule objects are constructed.
coverage.decode_error_partial_mutation: UNTESTED: exact error text is covered, but object/decoder state remaining after each exception is not serialized.
coverage.reverse_justified_big_endian_pentry: UNTESTED: the locked x86-64 compiler spec is little-endian and does not exercise reverse-justified big-endian address spaces.
coverage.register_strategy_paramlists: UNTESTED: all serialized prototype/resource observations use the standard strategy; ParamListRegister/ParamListRegisterOut subclass behavior is not represented.
coverage.create_model_alias_and_is_compatible: MISMATCH: payload copying is present, but the Rust bool adapter does not preserve Ghidra's alias-parent identity or merged/alias-parent/duplicate/missing-parent exception domain; this API is outside the declared fixture observations.
coverage.set_default_model_unknown_name_adapter: MISMATCH: the Rust &str adapter silently returns for an unknown map name; Ghidra's setDefaultModel takes an already-resolved ProtoModel pointer and has no equivalent unknown-name input.

overall_status: MISMATCH: every declared observation is byte-identical to locked Ghidra 12.0.4, but production x86-64-gcc.cspec text ingestion, <modelrule> construction/behavior, alias compatibility/error semantics, and the unknown-name default adapter remain mismatched; resolveprototype, join, default-return, exception partial-state, reverse-justified big-endian, and register-strategy branches remain untested.
